hook: Lúcia Soares is listed by Reuters Events as Chief Information Officer and Head of Technology Transformation, Carlyle, among the speakers at Momentum AI Finance 2026 in New York. According to Lúcia Soares's LinkedIn profile, the current post at The Carlyle Group, partner, CIO and head of tech transformation, began in November 2023; the profile dates the start at Carlyle to 2019.

editor_points.desc: According to Lúcia Soares's LinkedIn profile: partner, CIO and head of tech transformation at The Carlyle Group since November 2023, and at Carlyle since 2019, where earlier roles were portfolio CIO for the Americas and CIO for global portfolio solutions; board member of Hexaware Technologies and of Hilb Group; VP of healthcare technology strategy at Johnson and Johnson from 2015 to 2018. MBA, San Jose State. The listing prints the name as Lucia Soares; the profile as Lúcia. The profile is Lúcia Soares's own account and has not been checked against other records.
